lore.tolerable_creepers.creeper_spores: Spores dropped by Creepers. Throw them to burst into a small cloud that spawns friendly Creepies.
lore.tolerable_creepers.spore_bomb: A bundle of Creeper Spores that bursts into a big spore cloud when thrown.
lore.tolerable_creepers.spore_barrel: A barrel packed with Creeper Spores, for compact storage.
lore.tolerable_creepers.mischief_arrow: An arrow tipped with Creeper Spores. It bursts into a spore cloud where it lands.
entity.tolerable_creepers.creepie.descri: A tiny Creeper hatched from a spore cloud. Creepies spawned by players are friendly and fight for them.
